_doc: Default quota priors per subscription plan, applied when discovery reports an account's plan and that account's configured plan differs. Figures are API-equivalent list-price priors, not a claim about any machine. Override per family/plan with a top-level plan_templates object in accounts.local.json. Only windows, capacity_usd, capacity_change and burn_pct_per_worker_hour are copied onto an account; every other key (provenance, basis, notes, pre_* values) is documentation. Calibrated 2026-10-30 against capacity-audit-2026-10-30.md.

_provenance_values.measured_local: Aggregated from this host's own usage samples (Δ list-price USD ÷ Δ percentage points).
_provenance_values.measured_local_and_community: Measured locally and independently confirmed by a multi-account community panel.
_provenance_values.measured_local_halved_2026_10_30: Measured locally under the previous allowance, then halved for the 2026-10-30 allowance cut; not re-measured.
_provenance_values.community_measured: Community-measured median from multi-window samples; no local account of this plan.
_provenance_values.community_prior: Anchored on community measurements (not an exact ratio of another plan); no local account and no direct sample.
_provenance_values.community_prior_unverified_weekly: Only the 5-hour ratio is official; the weekly figure is a community estimate or a proportional scale with no measurement.
_provenance_values.relative_scale_from_local_pct_burn: A routing scale derived from locally measured percentage burn and an assumed hourly cost; not billed USD.
_provenance_values.derived_50pct_cap: Derived from Anthropic's published rule that Fable may use at most 50% of the weekly allowance; never consumed locally.
_provenance_values.guard_value: A launch guard, not measured capacity.

pro.basis: seven_day 156: local claude-2 aggregate $169, Wokey 103-account median $157. five_hour 18 is the launch guard (25% launch floor, 12% margin); measured capacity is about $13 locally and $11 per window in the Wokey panel. No weekly_fable window: Claude Pro includes no Fable allowance (Fable is billed from usage credits), so the former 78 (= 156/2) was invented and is removed.

max5.burn_basis: No local Max 5x account. five_hour from the official 1:4 ratio to Max 20x and the FinOps full-window range ($93-$127); seven_day from the FinOps lower bound (a busiest week of $1,217-$1,461 that did not hit the cap, about 58% of Max 20x), not 1/4. Community 20x:5x weekly ratios run 1.3x-2.0x, not 4x. The earlier 595/94/298/1.08 were max20 divided by four.

max20.basis: Local: two full weekly cycles $2,410 / $2,396 and 53 five-hour windows aggregating $390. Community: Wokey 21-account median seven_day $1,602 and five_hour $263; FinOps seven_day $1,860. The local figures run higher because the workload is mostly Opus 5.5 with 1h cache writes. weekly_fable is derived from the 50% rule and was never consumed locally.

plus.basis: FinOps: 27 full weekly cycles, median $67 per week (range $61-$81). Burn assumes the same roughly $10 per worker-hour as the Pro rows.

pro100.basis: FinOps: median $175 per week, only 2.6x Plus rather than the advertised 5x. Burn assumes the same roughly $10 per worker-hour.

pro.basis: Local aggregate over 8 weekly cycles was $574 under the 20x allowance that applied before 2026-10-30. From 2026-10-30 OpenAI halves the Pro $200 Codex allowance (20x to 10x): FinOps converts that to about $351, and half of the local figure is $287; 325 sits between. Burn doubles from 1.74 to 3.48 for the same workload. Re-measure after a full post-cut cycle.

ultra20.basis: This host is on Google AI Ultra 20x. What was measured is percentage burn: Argon about 0.62%/h of the weekly Gemini pool and about 2.1-2.2%/h of the 5h pool, Flash about 0.08%/h weekly. The USD figures are a routing scale, not billed USD: Argon's assumed $4/h of equivalent work divided by the measured 0.62%/h gives gemini-weekly 625, with the 5h and third-party rows scaled from it; the 3p rows have no sample and are a placeholder for an independent fixed pool. Community estimates for Ultra 20x are about $800 per week and $200 per 5h. Keep 625/182/88/17.6 so Claude/Codex cost-effectiveness comparisons stay aligned; the same values are hard-coded in allocator.window_capacity_usd.

ultra5.basis: Google guarantees only that the 5h allowance is 1/4 of Ultra 20x; no weekly multiple is published. Values here are the Ultra 20x routing scale divided by four (community estimate: 5h about $50, weekly $200-$600). Spec-level burn is multiplied by four for the smaller pool.

pro.basis: Google guarantees only that the 5h allowance is 1/20 of Ultra 20x; no weekly multiple is published. Values here are the Ultra 20x routing scale divided by twenty (community estimate: 5h about $3.75-$10, weekly $15-$40). Spec-level burn is multiplied by twenty for the smaller pool.
